boundaries.processing: mapshaper weighted 8% keep-shapes, precision=0.00001; D3 spherical winding normalization
boundaries.limitations: Historical census boundaries, not current legal administrative divisions. Simplified display geometry.

hierarchy.processing: Topological union of actual 2018 municipal polygons. General-city districts in provinces are dissolved to city boundaries; metropolitan districts remain terminal. All original region codes are retained as legacy aliases.

restAreas.processing: Extract factual names, route numbers, directions and WGS84 latitude/longitude; no invented coordinates
restAreas.limitations: Third-party snapshot; original survey date and comprehensive coverage are not documented. Not a direct live Korea Expressway Corporation feed.

display.grouping: Same base name and route; direction suffix ignored. One original coordinate represents each group; every original ID remains a record alias.
display.recording: 82 paired groups use square markers and separate original-point direction/destination tabs. 46 single-point facilities use circle markers. Records retain original point IDs and can move directions during editing; aggregate marker counts remain shared.

dokdo.processing: Extract only the original east and west Dokdo islet polygons from Ulleung-eup; normalize ring winding for D3, no simplification, rescaling or relocation. Append to Ulleung county before deriving provincial boundaries.
dokdo.license: CC BY 4.0; underlying SGIS KOGL Type 1 attribution retained in DOKDO-LICENSE.txt and app data dialog.
dokdo.verification: Each reference point is inside its islet polygon. Nearest sampled shoreline vertices are ~87.64 km from Ulleung, southeast bearing. Coordinates remain within 131.8632–131.8713 E, 37.2383–37.2443 N.

highways.processing: Keep expressway=1 original LineStrings within Korean bounding box whose middle vertex lies within a province. No joining, interpolation or rest-area-derived geometry. scripts/prepare-highways.mjs checks source checksum.
highways.limitations: Historical generalized 1:10 million roads, not current navigation geometry. Missing recent roads and ramps; no route identifiers. Route filters apply only to rest-area markers, not road lines.
